program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed ?? 4; const gravity = inputs.gravity ?? 9.8; const mass = inputs.mass ?? 1.0; const t = Math.max(0, time); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Rising"; if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } else if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (velocity < 0 && height > 0) { motionState = "Falling"; } else if (height <= 0 && t > 0) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 30, w: 280, h: 330, title: "The Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 50, y: 340, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m", ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0] })); const ballY = 340 - (height / 2.2) * 260; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 150, ballY, 24, { role: "observed" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 180, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 210, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(235, ballY - 25, ["v: " + velocity.toFixed(2) + " m/s", "a: " + acceleration.toFixed(1) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + force.toFixed(1) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); const points = []; const stepCount = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= stepCount; i++) { const ti = (i / stepCount) * 1.6666666; const vi = launchSpeed - gravity * ti; points.push([ti, vi]); } objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 330, y: 30, w: 290, h: 330, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.6666666, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 475, 335, "slope a = -g", { align: "middle" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, mass: mass, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, height: height, velocity: velocity, acceleration: acceleration, force: force } }; }
